resources.string:
This sample demonstrates AbstractMapTool — the base class for tools that draw on the 3-D WorldWind map surface.

Tap the map to place a placemark at the tapped location. The status bar shows the last tapped coordinates (latitude, longitude).

Placemarks are added to the tool's managed RenderableLayer and cleared when the tool is deactivated. Each tap also calls requestRedraw() so the new placemark appears immediately.
Tap anywhere on the map to drop a placemark at that position.
Each placemark is a WorldWind Placemark added via AbstractMapTool.addRenderable(). All renderables are automatically removed when the tool is deactivated.
